title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy child-src allows a wildcard source
description: The Content-Security-Policy child-src directive contains a bare wildcard. child-src is the fallback for frame-src and worker-src, so on policies that do not set those two directives it decides which origins may be framed or started as workers.
applicability: HTTPS responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit child-src directive.
risk: Frames and workers may be loaded from any origin on policies that rely on child-src; LOW severity because explicit frame-src or worker-src rules take precedence.
